question: A man driving a car at a speed of 72 km/hr crosses a bridge in 4.9 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert time directly to hours and multiply by speed.

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 72 × (4.9 / 60)

Distance = 1.2 × 4.9 = 5.88 km

**∴ The correct answer is 5.88 km.**
